findings.currentPlan: Omgevingsplan Haarlem CVDR696299 remains controlling spatial source.
findings.currentRules: Huisvestingsverordening Zuid-Kennemerland/IJmond, Haarlem 2026 and Beleidsregels wijzigingen in de woonruimtevoorraad gemeente Haarlem 2026 are current from 01-01-2026.
findings.buildingSplit: Always requires an omgevingsvergunning plus a permit for woningvormen or omzetten. Original house generally at least 140 m2, apartment 100 m2; resulting independent units at least 50 m2. In designated neighbourhoods only buildings above 250 m2 may be split.
findings.roomRental: Conversion to rooms requires shared room at least 11 m2 and rooms at least 12 m2; at 5+ rooms management must be by a company/foundation.
documents: proposed drawing scale 1:100 or building permit
cadastreDocuments: post-split drawing minimum scale 1:100 with exact use area
